settings.heading: Your LinkedIn Profile Is Being Searched. Make It Findable.
settings.content: Recruiters search LinkedIn using keywords, the same way employers scan resumes with ATS software. A profile with a generic headline and a thin About section simply doesn't surface in those searches — no matter how strong your actual experience is. We rewrite every section of your profile to be specific, keyword-aligned, and written in a voice that sounds like you.

settings.heading: Every Section That Affects Recruiter Visibility
settings.subheading: LinkedIn Optimization covers your full profile, not just a single section.

settings.title: Headline
settings.text: A keyword-rich headline that goes beyond your job title, since it's one of the most heavily weighted fields in LinkedIn search.

settings.title: About Section
settings.text: A first-person summary that reads naturally while working key terms recruiters actually search for into the text.

settings.title: Experience Rewrite
settings.text: Each role rewritten around outcomes, mirroring the achievement-based approach we use in resumes.

settings.title: Skills Optimization
settings.text: Skills section reordered and refined to match what's actually searched for in your target roles.

settings.title: Keyword Optimization
settings.text: Industry and role-specific keywords woven naturally throughout your profile, not stuffed in a list.

settings.title: Profile Review
settings.text: A full review of photo guidance, banner, featured section, and overall profile completeness.

settings.heading: One Consistent Story, Everywhere You're Seen
settings.text: Your resume, cover letter, and LinkedIn profile should all sound like the same professional — not three disconnected documents. LinkedIn Optimization is built to align with your resume's positioning, so recruiters see a consistent, credible narrative whichever they read first.

settings.question: Do you need access to my LinkedIn account?
settings.answer: No. We deliver your optimized content as a document for you to paste into your own profile, so you never need to share your login.

settings.question: Will this help recruiters find me?
settings.answer: Optimized keywords, headline, and skills are the primary factors LinkedIn's search uses to surface profiles to recruiters — improving them is intended to increase visibility, though we can't guarantee specific search rankings or outreach volume.

settings.question: Can LinkedIn Optimization be combined with a resume?
settings.answer: Yes — the Job Hunter Bundle and higher-tier packages combine resume, cover letter, and full LinkedIn Optimization at a bundled price.

settings.heading: Turn Your LinkedIn Profile Into a Recruiter Magnet
settings.text: Get a full LinkedIn Optimization — headline, About, experience, skills, and keywords — in 5 business days.
